DIGITAL GOLD

Build Gold with Small, Regular Savings

Start with an amount that works for you and build Gold gradually. Explore your options and understand the details before you begin.

What is Digital Gold?

Digital Gold lets you purchase Gold online by value or quantity. Review the provider’s ownership, purity and custody terms before purchasing. Your purchased holdings can be tracked in the provided platform.

How Gold savings work

Choose an amount, review the current Gold price and applicable taxes or charges, and confirm your purchase in the Augmont flow. The final quantity is calculated using the price displayed at confirmation and is added to your holdings after successful payment, according to provider terms.

One-time or recurring savings

Choose a one-time purchase or one of the recurring options supported by the provider. Check minimum amounts, debit timing, failed-payment handling, and pause or cancellation rules before setting up regular purchases.

Sell, redeem or take delivery

Depending on the options supported, you may sell for cash, request physical delivery, or redeem through a jewellery partner. Minimum quantities, delivery or making charges, processing time and serviceable locations vary by route.

Questions about Gold savings

What is the minimum amount?+

The applicable minimum and maximum amounts are shown in the Augmont transaction flow. Confirm the current limits before you purchase.

Can I sell, redeem, or request physical delivery?+

Use the options supported by Augmont for your account. Availability, minimum quantities, delivery or making charges, serviceable locations and processing timelines are subject to its current terms.

What charges and taxes apply?+

Review the current buy price, applicable taxes, fees and final quantity in the transaction flow before confirming. Buy and sell prices can differ.

Can I save regularly?+

Recurring purchases depend on the options available in the Augmont flow. Check supported intervals, payment instructions, and pause or cancellation rules before setting one up.

Who provides the transaction service?+

Transactions are handled through the separate Augmont experience. Dhanvoraa is the brand and education website. Start saving currently opens the supplied Augmont demo.
